description:
This was a test. Perhaps the toughest Barça have faced all season. But when the questions became difficult, Raphinha once again had all the answers.

At the Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán, the Brazilian captain scored his second hat-trick in two games, taking his tally to 12 goals in the first seven Liga fixtures, as Hansi Flick’s side came from behind to beat in-form Sevilla 3–1.
